_recipe.title: Real estate / food showcase
_recipe.when: A premium place: an apartment, villa, plot, café, restaurant, bakery or boutique stay. Calm, magazine-style 9:16 for Reels and Shorts.
beats: Hook: where it is (kicker) + one evocative line, readable instantly.
Atmosphere: three sensory details as kinetic lines (light, view, smell, taste).
The details: four facts as tiles (size, rooms, amenity, location / dish, seating, timing).
Price: "starting at" with the real number and what it includes.
Proof: a resident's or guest's real review with stars.
Visit: day, time and address, the frame people screenshot.
CTA: a quiet "Book a visit →" / "Reserve a table →" link.
copyTips: Food version: kicker = area, lines = taste / smell / sound, tiles = signature dishes + seating + hours, price = "for two", CTA = "Reserve a table".
Property: carpet area, configuration, possession date, price and any RERA number must come from the developer or agent. Never round a price down.
Write the atmosphere lines as images, not adjectives: "Sunlight till six." beats "Very bright."
Have photos? Replace beat 2 or 3 with "image" scenes (files in public/images/, "move": "in") and keep the captions to 2-5 words.
Editorial (cream paper, serif) feels premium. Budget / family places: --theme clean. Festive openings: --theme desi.
